title: Classify the deployment and settle who is provider and deployer
what_to_do: Answer the classification questions for this deployment: who uses the output and for what decision, whether Annex III point 8(a) applies, whether Article 6(3) is relied on, and who is provider and who is deployer.

title: Assess the impact on fundamental rights and personal data
what_to_do: Answer the impact questions: the process, the people affected, the personal data, the harms and the controls against each, oversight, fallback, complaints and consultation. One form serves the fundamental-rights assessment (where Art. 27 applies to the deployer), the data-protection impact assessment and the ISO/IEC 42001 AI system impact assessment.

title: Train everyone who uses the system
what_to_do: Record, for each person who works on matters, the AI-literacy and instructions-for-use training they completed. A named reviewer without a current record is reported by the routine checks.

title: Review the risks
what_to_do: Read the risk register against how the system is being used, and record what changed.
statement: I have reviewed the risk register against current use; the risks, controls and residual risks it states are current, or the changes are recorded in the notes.

title: Sign off the technical documentation
what_to_do: Generate the Annex IV technical documentation from the system's own records, complete what only the provider can state, and sign it off.
statement: I have reviewed the technical documentation generated by the system, completed the parts only the provider can state, and it describes the system as deployed.

title: Issue the instructions for use
what_to_do: Adapt the instructions for use to this deployment and give them to every user.
statement: The instructions for use have been adapted to this deployment and given to everyone who uses the system.

title: Evaluate accuracy against declared thresholds
what_to_do: Run the evaluation: the system prepares a matter with known defects planted in it and measures how many it caught, against the thresholds you declare.

title: Keep a quality management system
what_to_do: Record where the quality management system that covers this system is documented and who runs it.
statement: A quality management system covering this AI system is documented and in operation.

title: Set retention periods
what_to_do: Set how long the audit trail is kept (at least six months, Art. 26(6) and 19) and how long a closed matter's documents are kept before deletion; the routine checks then delete on time.

title: Assign competent human oversight
what_to_do: Name who reviews output on each kind of matter, and confirm they have the competence, training, authority and time to do so.
statement: The people who review this system's output have the competence, training and authority to do so and the time to do it properly, and can stop or disregard it.

title: Carry out the conformity assessment
what_to_do: Carry out the internal-control conformity assessment (Annex VI): confirm the quality management system, examine the technical documentation, and confirm the design and post-market monitoring are consistent with it. The system shows which of the other actions are complete.
statement: The internal-control conformity assessment under Annex VI has been carried out: the quality management system complies with Art. 17, the technical documentation has been examined, and the design, development and post-market monitoring are consistent with it.

title: Draw up the EU declaration of conformity
what_to_do: Generate the draft declaration from the system's records, complete the provider's details, sign it, and affix the CE marking.
statement: The EU declaration of conformity has been drawn up and signed for this system and the CE marking affixed.

title: Register the system
what_to_do: Register the system in the EU database before it is placed on the market or put into service, and record the registration number.

title: Tell people the system is used
what_to_do: Tell the parties and others affected that an AI system assists the preparation of the case, in the way the deployment requires.
statement: People affected by its use are told that an AI system assists case preparation.

title: Keep post-market monitoring and incident reporting ready
what_to_do: Record the post-market monitoring plan, who decides whether an incident is serious, who reports it to the market surveillance authority and how they are reached.
statement: A post-market monitoring plan is in place; it names who decides whether an incident is serious, who reports it, and the contact point for the authorities.

title: Secure the machines it runs on
what_to_do: Confirm the deployment provides what the software cannot: encryption of stored data, backups, patching and network controls.
statement: The machines and storage this system runs on are encrypted, backed up, patched and network-controlled.

title: Apply national data-protection rules
what_to_do: Record how the member state's own data-protection rules apply (criminal-offence data, restrictions on data-subject rights in proceedings, privilege, courts acting judicially).
statement: The national rules completing the GDPR in this member state have been assessed for this use.

title: Review monitoring
what_to_do: Read the monitoring figures (failed checks, overrides, unchallenged approvals, incidents) and record what was decided.
statement: I have reviewed the monitoring figures for the period and recorded any action taken.

title: Settle the supply chain
what_to_do: Record whether an importer, a distributor or an authorised representative is involved, and if so who they are.
statement: Whether an importer, distributor or authorised representative is involved has been determined and recorded.

title: Record the lawful basis and the records of processing
what_to_do: Record the lawful basis for processing the personal data in matters and keep the record of processing activities.
statement: The lawful basis for the processing is recorded and the record of processing activities covers this system.

title: State the data governance
what_to_do: State how the data this system reads is governed: that no model is trained on matter data, how models are chosen, and how legal sources are approved.
statement: No model is trained on matter data; models and legal sources are chosen and approved as recorded.

title: Assess each change before use
what_to_do: When a model, prompt, workflow, policy, source or package changes, complete the change assessment before it is used on a matter.
